title: The *Authorization* Gap
dek: Anthropic's agents outwork humans 6:1. Banks block them manually. Campaigns run AI-fabricated ads because no law says they cannot.

stories.label: AI agent to human staff working hours at Anthropic by August
stories.headline: The bottleneck at the company most worried about AI is now human attention, not compute.

stories.label: pledged by OpenAI, Anthropic and Simons to verify AI-generated math
stories.headline: Only 42% of OpenAI's published math results have been formally verified.

stories.label: of unauthorized AI agent attempts blocked by Schwab every week
stories.headline: Banks are not drawing a security line. They are deciding who controls the execution path.

stories.label: valuation of Winverse AI seed round, led by DeepSeek
stories.headline: China's model companies are seeding physical AI at seed round, not Series B.

stories.label: parameter models now runnable locally on NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops
stories.headline: When a 120B model runs on a laptop, the data stays on device. So does what would have checked it.

stories.label: Nscale NYSE IPO target, revenue up 1,252% year-over-year
stories.headline: Investors are being asked to pay $30B for $51B in contracted revenue that has not yet arrived.

stories.label: spent on AI-generated midterm ads, 73% carrying no disclosure label
stories.headline: The one-cycle leap from under $50K to $137M is not a disclosure gap. It is a precedent.

still_signal: The question in every story today is the same: who authorized this? The permission layer is the constraint now. It was never built to run at this speed.
